w: Built by the Teutonic Order between 1274 and 1406, this Brick Gothic fortress is the largest castle on Earth by land area. Bohemian mercenaries sold it to King Casimir IV in 1457, mid-Thirteen Years' War; it served as a Polish royal residence until 1772, then some 170 years under German rule. UNESCO-listed.
s: Largest brick castle on Earth, built by crusading knights
_facts: Largest castle in the world by land area; largest brick castle on completion
Sold to King Casimir IV of Poland in 1457 during the Thirteen Years' War
